digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and plan-review close gate
propositions: Acceptance criteria that are invalidated by the fix or later work have no documented legitimate close path; agents resort to --force-close or --ref to older commits, both of which leave inaccurate ticket state.
When acceptance criteria no longer match reality, the correct workflow is to edit the ticket, re-pass plan review, and close against corrected criteria; this must be documented.
The --ref <landing-commit> flag is a legitimate close path for criteria invalidated by subsequent work but is not documented as such in the close workflow.
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check forces full re-review of already-executed plans when the criteria registry changes, stranding completed work.
Auto-generated and automation-owned closure paths for bot-filed alert tickets are out of scope but represent unresolved subclasses of the same problem.

Criteria disposition tracking (moot/invalidated/superseded) with auditable evidence and provenance should be designed as a durable contract across both completion verifier and plan-review close gates.
